notes: v494 — four things found by a full audit of the maths, the actions and the speed. The auto-pilot could set a stop-loss AT the price it just paid on very cheap shares, because an 8% stop rounds to the same tick — it now refuses those and says why, exactly as the manual buy screen already did. The sell dialog's preview left brokerage out, so a small trade could promise a profit and record a loss; it now uses the same arithmetic as the ledger. And two speed faults: every share's history was being sorted twice on every prepare, and Smart Money re-ran the whole calculation on every press. Loading is about a quarter faster and a second Smart Money press is now instant. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
